text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-r-k-e-d t-h-e m-a-t-t-e-r as c-l-o-s-e-d and l-e-f-t a f-i-l-e-d n-o-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) they r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d t-h-e a-s-s-e-r-t-i-o-n and s-t-o-r-e-d t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n.
3) the p-l-a-n w-a-s l-o-g-g-e-d as a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e and n-o-t-e-d i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l l-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g.
4) they i-g-n-o-r-e-d t-h-e a-l-e-r-t s-i-g-n-a-l and s-e-a-l-e-d t-h-e f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g e-s-c-a-l-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-r-c-h-i-v-a-l s-t-e-p w-a-s c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d and c-h-a-r-i-t-y l-o-g-s s-t-a-y-e-d s-t-a-t-i-c w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t-i-n-g.
